us.conditions: US citizens can enter Cabo Verde visa-free for up to 30 days; pre-registration on EASE (paying the TSA fee) is mandatory.

de.conditions: German and EU citizens enter Cabo Verde visa-free for up to 30 days with mandatory EASE TSA pre-registration.

gb.conditions: British passport holders can visit Cabo Verde visa-free for up to 30 days with required EASE pre-registration.

ru.conditions: Граждане РФ могут въезжать в Кабо-Верде без визы на срок до 60 дней. Обязательна регистрация на портале EASE.

dos.title: Register on the EASE portal before departure
dos.description: Pre-registering and paying the TSA airport security fee on ease.gov.cv avoids long queues and customs delays on arrival.

dos.title: Enjoy Morna music and the spirit of 'Morabeza'
dos.description: Experience live traditional Morna music made famous by Cesária Évora; 'Morabeza' represents deep warm island hospitality.

dos.title: Use Euros directly where convenient
dos.description: Because the Escudo is pegged to the Euro (1 EUR = 110 CVE), many hotels, restaurants, and taxis happily accept Euros.

donts.title: Don't swim on beaches with red warning flags
donts.description: Atlantic ocean undertows can be powerful on unprotected open shores; always swim in protected bays like Santa Maria.

donts.title: Don't drink tap water
donts.description: Tap water in Cabo Verde is produced by desalination and is not intended for direct drinking; drink bottled water.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 10% is customary in sit-down restaurants in tourist centers like Santa Maria and Sal Rei for attentive service.
